main_text.l: At Sociniani, in hoc paulo arrogantiores, qui
neque Europæis, paucis suæ sectæ exceptis, vel
unicum concedunt. Illi Europæ incolas, non nisi
luscos esse volunt; at Hi, plane Cæcos exifti-
mant.
FINIS.

page.notes: The running head is partly unclear; "recta" is read from a worn word. The "pro" at the end of line 3 is followed by a small mark, but it is read as the whole word "pro" before "diversitate". Greek and Hebrew: none on the page. The text is a plain Latin transcription; the italic passage "sua Genti soli binos oculos tribuant, Europaeis unum, Cateris neutrum" is set in italic type as printed. Some letters in the final paragraph are read from a low-resolution scan, so "lusco" and "Cæcos" are uncertain readings and should be checked against the original.
